gates.title: Per-image licensing, archive capture, and public availability
checked: Archive capture: dated Wayback record 19961221110042 acquired byte-exact via anonymous public access; source page captured with the archive toolbar.
Per-image record: all 28 visible embedded images individually acquired with capture timestamp and hash; none missing, none substituted.

Rights holder and terms: page marked '© 1996 CNET Inc. All rights reserved.'; third-party ad, game artwork and sponsor logos present; Internet Archive grants no license and limits use to noninfringing or fair use.
Access boundary respected: no account, payment, CAPTCHA, terms click-through, or watermark removal.
gates.reason: No license exists for the page or its images, and whether fair use or permission applies is a legal judgment. The register requires unknown rights to stay blocked.
gates.review_question: Rights decision for using an all-rights-reserved 1996 CNET page (with third-party ad, Magic: The Gathering artwork and sponsor logos) in the video: fair-use/commentary, seek permission, or drop?

claims.finding: Title 'DOWNLOAD.COM -- Welcome', '© 1996 CNET Inc.' footer, page-generation comment dated Sat Dec 21 1996, and archive memento 1996-12-21T11:00:42Z. It is the earliest download.com capture in the Wayback index.

claims.claim: Download.com was a shareware download site (SCRIPT.md:595-597 context)
claims.finding: Page meta description calls it a searchable 'software database of selected software files from CNET'. It shows Most popular / Newest titles / Top picks and software categories. It is an editorially curated catalogue; the capture does not show how authors submitted files. No script change proposed.
